name: @svayam-opensource/prj
description: DEPRECATED. prj is retired — the governance lifecycle ships as @svayam-opensource/gov-work (binary: gov), and build/deploy/data as gov-cicd. This version is a pure redirect shim: it runs no lifecycle logic, resolves no workspace, and touches no repository. It exists so an ALREADY-INSTALLED prj stops acting on the retired registry.yaml/project.yaml authority model. See https://github.com/Svayamtech/svm-prj-work/issues/290

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const f=require('./package.json').files||[];if(f.length!==1||f[0]!=='bin/'){console.error('BLOCKED: @svayam-opensource/prj may only ever ship the redirect shim (files must be exactly [\"bin/\"]). The bash CLI is FROZEN and must never be published again — see svm-prj-work:#290.');process.exit(1)}"
